column1: # MC6000MK2 — Denon DJ "MC6000MK2 MIDI CMD List" (MIDI Command List spreadsheet)
# The meter rows are printed as 0x83-0x89, which aren't MIDI data bytes; they're decimal 83-89 (0x53-0x59).
# Messages are given as 0x9n/0xBn with n = MIDI channel 0-3; the list does not say which deck uses which n,
# so every message is listed on n=0..3 and deck transport controls carry no expect. Note off is 0x8n.
# LEDs: 0xBn, data1 = ON/OFF/BLINK trigger, data2 = LED number.
